headline: Entergy announces quarterly dividend payment to shareholders
summary: Entergy's board of directors today declared a quarterly dividend payment of $0.64 per share on the company's common stock. The dividend is payable Sept. 1, 2026, to shareholders of record as of Aug. 13, 2026.

headline: Edison International Q2 Earnings Surpass Estimates, Revenues Miss
summary: EIX Q2 earnings surge 58.8% and beat estimates by 51%, while revenues decline and miss expectations.
